exposure: Gestational age at induction (37, 38, 39, 40, and 41 weeks)
cohort: 640,191 births in Victoria, Australia, from 2010 to 2018
finding: Induction of labor at 38 weeks of gestation or later was associated with increased odds of Cesarean birth but decreased odds of perinatal mortality only at 41 weeks gestation in nulliparous women with uncomplicated pregnancies.
mod_finding: Induction of labor (IOL) was associated with increased odds of cesarean birth (CB) for lower-risk nulliparous women.
